text:
clare: quick note — a new contributor reported the Ruby sampleapp CI failing with native ext build on mac-arm64 and also hit a streaming reconnect 401 during an integration smoke.
matt: can you paste the build error? usually missing headers or wrong arch.
clare: ```
extconf.rb:5:in `require': cannot load such file -- mkmf (LoadError)
clang: error: unknown argument: '-m64'
*** extconf.rb failed ***
```
jen: sounds like an x86 flag on arm64. For CI we should prefer cached arm64 gems or set proper build flags.
clare: added fallback `gem install ffi -- --enable-libffi-alloc` in the PR and pinned mac runner, fixes the build. PR: https://git.example.com/redwood/devex/pulls/410
devex-bot: PR 410 opened by clare in devex — reviewers requested: matt, jen
matt: thanks. Relatedly, the streaming 401: is that coming from short-lived onboarding tokens?
clare: yes. Flow was: initial stream got 401, token refresh happened, client retried but reused the keep-alive socket so server closed the stream. Result: silent stream drop.
jen: that's an SDK parity bug — other clients rebuild the request and force a new connection after auth refresh. We should do the same only for auth-triggered retries.
matt: open a tiny patch in rb-sdk to rebuild the HTTP request on 401->refresh for streaming endpoints. Add unit that simulates 401 then success.
clare: PR opened in rb-sdk: https://git.example.com/redwood/rb-sdk/pulls/120 — includes test and sampleapp smoke job update
ci-bot: build 9123 failed on mac-arm64 — https://ci.example.com/build/9123
clare: pinned image and cached prebuilt gem for arm64; CI green in branch now.
jen: also add a one-liner to the quickstart docs under "macOS prerequisites" mentioning brew deps for native gems to reduce onboarding friction.
matt: agreed. Also add a short paragraph in devex about token-refresh and long-lived streaming caveats.
clare: filing follow-ups: docs issue https://git.example.com/redwood/devex/issues/428 and rb-sdk bug issue https://git.example.com/redwood/rb-sdk/issues/67
clare: thanks all :thumbsup:
